name: Vial of Purest Water
summary: In the southern Barrens, Brine blesses pure water for a shaman initiate. Islen Waterseer needs it to prepare a water sapta that lets the initiate see elemental spirits.

sections.title: A Purified Offering
sections.body: Brine leads the initiate through trials of patience and cleansing, then seals the water in the vial. Its purity is untouched by corruption. Carry it across the Barrens to Islen Waterseer, who watches over a solitary shore. She needs the water to brew a water sapta, for only such pure water lets a shaman commune with spiritual guardians far from the sunbaked flats.

sections.title: Path to the Water Totem
sections.body: Islen Waterseer uses the blessed water to test the initiate’s dedication and open their senses to hidden elements. She blends some into a sapta, which reveals spirits at a distant shrine in Silverpine Forest. She keeps the remaining drops to confront and cleanse a rogue manifestation elsewhere. With the vial, the initiate leaves humble chores behind and faces elemental realities directly.

faq.q: What is the Vial of Purest Water used for?
faq.answer: The vial holds water cleansed and blessed for a shaman initiate. Islen Waterseer uses it to brew a water sapta, granting the spiritual sight needed to perceive water elementals. She also uses the water in further ritual trials required to earn the Water Totem.

faq.q: Who prepares the water inside the vial?
faq.answer: The shaman gathers the water under Brine’s direction. Brine is an orc shaman hermit deep in the southern Barrens. After the initiate’s trials, Brine blesses and seals the purified water in the vial for transport.

faq.q: Where does the vial need to be taken?
aliases: who do I give the vial to
faq.answer: Carry the vial to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens’ eastern shore, just south of Ratchet and overlooking the Great Sea.

faq.q: Where does the ritual lead after delivering the vial?
faq.answer: After receiving the vial and brewing the sapta, Islen Waterseer sends the shaman across the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms. The shrine lies in Silverpine Forest, south of the Undercity.

angles.text: As a shaman, delivering this purified water brings you through the final steps toward communing with water spirits and claiming your Water Totem.
As a Horde shaman, you cross Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms during the vial’s trials, deepening your bond with the elements.
